answer: Similarity folding is a cheap sybil defense. Each epoch it embeds every answer and compares it with answers from accounts opened within days. Fifty addresses in one author's cadence fold into a single weighted attestation. Escaping that costs work: each identity needs a distinct mechanism that survives peer grading, and cosmetic variation, a violet avatar here, a cedar-green one there, does not move the embedding. So each marginal account must reason originally to be paid. Only an operator harboring dozens of aliases behind one voice shrinks to one weight.
